page0.text:
...
My mind's made up.
My chances of victory are abysmal.
Even so...
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-15:page0:1

page1.text:
"I'm going to fight. I've got unfinished business with him.
I can't back off, no matter what. I have to defeat Kotomine."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-15:page1:1

page2.text:
I need to settle things with him.
As a survivor of the disaster ten years ago...
As one of the orphans...
As the son of Kiritsugu Emiya.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-15:page2:1

page3.text:
"I see. Then I'll give you this. It's meant for self-defense, but it's better than nothing."
Tohsaka reaches behind her and takes out a dagger.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-15:page3:1
